fact: The government's September 2025 record sheet for 2011-2025 counts 114 commissariats in 2011 with 35 new ones opened since, gendarmerie brigades rising from 153 in 2011 to 203 in 2024/2025, and 105 sites interconnected through SIPAO, and lists among post-2025 prospects the extension of SIGAPP (Système Intégré de Gestion Applications et Procédures Police); it does not say what the 105 sites are or what is entered at them.
title: Bilan 2011-2025 : Paix, sécurité et justice
